description: Find services advertising stablecoin payments over x402 or MPP. HTTP endpoints are probed; live=true means the endpoint returned HTTP 402 or a detected payment-challenge signal at its last unpaid probe.

category.description: A top-level category (data, crypto, trading, search, inference, media, social, infra, security) or a subcategory, such as crypto-data or finance

environment.description: mainnet, testnet, mixed (offers both) or unknown: from the networks its last payment challenge offered, else its listed chains

live_only.description: Only services whose last probe detected a payment challenge

q.description: Free-text search over name, title, tags, listing category, description, endpoint and each call's URL template, description and parameter names

name: find_services
title: Find payable services
